payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including the use of a variant of Byte-Pair Encoding and a mix-source method.

claims.text: A variant of Byte-Pair Encoding algorithm was proposed to perform effective word segmentation for Vietnamese texts, alleviating the rare-word problem in NMT systems.
The mix-source method utilizes monolingual data of the target language in a multilingual NMT system to help address data sparsity.
Experimentation with translation units at different levels (subword, word, and beyond) was conducted to deal with rare-word translation problems.
